## reference · Ahrefs 75K brand study
* The Ahrefs 75K Brand Study analyzed 75,000 brands with a Domain Rating above 40.
* Brand mentions correlate 3x more strongly with AI visibility than backlinks.
* YouTube mentions are the strongest single predictor of AI visibility at r=0.737.
* Branded web mentions correlate with AI visibility at r=0.656-0.709.
* Backlinks correlate with AI visibility at r=0.218, 3x weaker than brand mentions.
* Brands in the top quartile for web mentions receive 10 times more AI Overview mentions than the next quartile.
* 96% of AI citations come from earned media, not from own domains.
* Only 11% of ChatGPT citations link to the brand being discussed itself.
* Share of Model (SoM) measures how often, prominently, and positively a brand appears in AI responses.
* Priority shifts from on-site to off-site: YouTube presence, Reddit engagement, G2/Capterra reviews, industry publications, and PR placements are the new backlinks of the AI era.
* The average AI search visitor is 4.4 times more valuable than a classic organic visitor.
* AI search could bring more traffic than classic search by early 2028.
* GEO can increase visibility in generative answers by up to 40%.
* 50% of internet users in Germany use AI chats at least occasionally.
* 70% of Austrian consumers use an AI service at least rarely.
* For AI visibility, brand mentions are more important than backlinks.
* YouTube mentions are crucial for AI visibility due to direct processing of YouTube transcripts by Google and its AI systems.
